snippet.title: Rue Valley - Story Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
Break free from a mysterious time loop in Rue Valley. You’re trapped in the enigmatic town of Rue Valley and must navigate each iteration of your day to uncover hidden secrets, reclaim your mind, and heal the fracture in your life.

Choose your personality, explore complex emotional stories, and shape the narrative through memory graphs and status-effects that reflect your mood, mindsets, and interactions. With comic-book visuals, rich character arcs, and a looping structure built to challenge you from the inside out, Rue Valley is about self-discovery, resilience and the truth lurking beneath the surface.

Available on PC and consoles from 11 November 2025. Wishlist now and prepare for the loop.
